id: \bSo you are my last challenger? Alright, let's begin.
en: \bSo you are my last challenger? Alright, let's begin.
it: \bQuindi sei tu il mio ultimo sfidante? Bene, cominciamo.

id: \bYou were outstanding. Here, take this as a reward for winning the tournament.
en: \bYou were outstanding. Here, take this as a reward for winning the tournament.
it: \bSei stato eccezionale. Ecco, prendi questo come premio per aver vinto il torneo.

id: \bAnthony: You have proven yourself. I will train any Pokémon you wish.
en: \bAnthony: You have proven yourself. I will train any Pokémon you wish.
it: \bAnthony: Hai dimostrato il tuo valore. Allenerò qualsiasi Pokémon tu voglia.

id: \bOh? But you only have one with you.
en: \bOh?  But you only have one with you.
it: \bOh? Ma ne hai solo uno con te.

id: \bWhich Pokémon would you like me to raise?
en: \bWhich Pokémon would you like me to raise?

id: \bIf you leave me that Pokémon, what will you battle with?
en: \bIf you leave me that Pokémon, what will you battle with?
it: \bSe mi lasci quel Pokémon, con cosa lotterai?
\bTorna quando avrai un po' di buon senso.

id: \bI can raise two of your Pokémon. Would you like me to raise another?
en: \bI can raise two of your Pokémon. Would you like me to raise another?
it: \bPosso allenare due dei tuoi Pokémon. Vuoi che ne alleni un altro?

id: \bOh? But you only have one Pokémon with you.
en: \bOh? But you only have one Pokémon with you.
it: \bOh? Ma hai solo un Pokémon con te.

id: \bYou can't go off without a Pokémon. Come back another time.
en: \bYou can't go off without a Pokémon. Come back another time.
it: \bNon puoi andartene in giro senza un Pokémon. Torna un'altra volta.

id: \bWhich Pokémon should I raise for you?
en: \bWhich Pokémon should I raise for you?

id: \bI can always train one for you.
en: \bI can always train one for you.

id: \bFine, I'll raise your \v[3] for a while.
en: \bFine, I'll raise your \v[3] for a while.
it: \bBene, allenerò il tuo \v[3] per un po'.

id: \bHey \PN. How's it going? Your Pokémon got stronger.
en: \bHey \PN. How's it going? Your Pokémon got stronger.
it: \bEhi, \PN. Come va? Il tuo Pokémon è diventato più forte.

id: \bBy level, your \v[3] has grown by about \v[4].
en: \bBy level, your \v[3] has grown by about \v[4].
it: \bIl tuo \v[3] è salito di circa \v[4] livelli.

id: \bYour Pokémon team is full. Make room, then come see me.
en: \bYour Pokémon team is full. Make room, then come see me.
it: \bLa tua squadra è al completo. Fai spazio, poi torna da me.

id: Which one do you want back?
en: Which one do you want back?

id: \G\bIf you want your \v[3] back, it will cost $\v[4].
en: \G\bIf you want your \v[3] back, it will cost $\v[4].
it: \G\bSe vuoi riavere il tuo \v[3], ti costerà $\v[4].

id: \bDo you want to take back the other one, too?
en: \bDo you want to take back the other one, too?

id: \bBrock: Hey \Pn. So you're entering the tourtament too? Alright! Lets get started.
en: \bBrock: Hey \Pn. So you're entering the tourtament too? Alright! Lets get started.
it: \bBrock: Ehi, \Pn. Allora partecipi anche tu al torneo? Grande! Cominciamo.

id: \bBrock: I'll get stronger too. Until then keep working hard \PN.
en: \bBrock: I'll get stronger too. Until then keep working hard \PN.
it: \bBrock: Diventerò più forte anch'io. Fino ad allora, continua a impegnarti, \PN.
